canonical_project: Silicon Foundation Wheeling / Centre Foundry data center
owner: Silicon Foundation Energy LLC / Silicon Foundry Energy LLC (reported purchaser; assessor record still lags)
capacity_note: Confirmed current/Phase 1 grid connection is 10 MW; 20-30 MW expansion, 50 MW revised representation, and 100 MW long-term campus remain projected/conflicting.
status: announced; preliminary local discussions; no formal city plans or documentation confirmed
why_not_in_baseline: Old-factory/industrial parcel conversion in a small West Virginia market; baseline did not include Silicon Foundation, Wheeling, or Centre Foundry.

contradictions.details: Initial industry/project coverage described a possible 100 MW campus; company official later said current setup is only 10 MW and 100 MW would require rebuilding area grid infrastructure; WTOV later reported officials were told the project would be limited to 50 MW. Treat 10 MW as verified current/Phase 1 and larger values as projected or unresolved.

Local reporting says Silicon Foundation/Silicon Foundry Energy purchased the site in April 2026, but the Ohio County Assessor public parcel page still lists Centre Foundry & Machine Co. as current owner and shows an older deed book/page.

City of Wheeling stated on 2026-06-25 that no formal plans, drawings, proposals, or specific development details had been presented; later local reporting confirms public discussion and city fact-finding but not a filed local approval or construction start.

history.reason: Refreshed to confirmed current/Phase 1 grid connection; retained 50/100 MW claims as projected/conflicting.
